投稿者: William アメリカのCamp Director ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great for small camp and conference centers."
良い点: The software is very customizable and affordable. It has allowed me to create an online booking system for our camp and retreat center. The biggest advantage is that it provides most of the functionality we need, at half the price, or less, of other camp booking systems. The pictures and video option for our various cabin rentals is great.
改善点: There are a few minor function problems that I wish would be fixed. We sometimes have a group of folks who set up a booking together. They then want to pay separately, and there is no place to input the credit card zip code on the payment page. I have to go back and edit the original booking zip code to do this. Again, it’s a minor issue, but would be a nice feature. One other one would be an option to print a payment receipt, rather than just printing an Invoice that lists the payment being made.

良い点: Checkfront was pretty easy to get going with and to set up.
改善点: I wish checkfront had a more modern/clean aesthetic, or at least made it easy to customise the style to better match the style of different websites/companies.

タイトル: They kept asking me to write a review, so here it is!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 個人および家族向けサービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "They kept asking me to write a review, so here it is!"
良い点: On paper, it seemed like a good option, good value for money without the (IMHO crazy) expectations for customers or tour operators to pay high (6%) commission fees.
改善点: It did not have the core functionality or flexibility to allow me to do (i) multi-day tours and (ii) resource management to automatically manage seats and minibus availability. I considfered this to be a very basic need for my small tour guiding business (we only operate one vehicle and one tour at a time).

タイトル: Great customer service comes through when the software is difficult for a layman to understand
投稿者: Anna Maria ギリシャのOwner ワイン、スピリッツ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great customer service comes through when the software is difficult for a layman to understand"
良い点: The software does everything I need it to do as a small business that has varying needs for our different tour options. It takes a while to get used to but the features are great and our customers find it easy to use and book online.
改善点: It's not very intuitive in terms of the parameters and trouble shooting. However, the customer service agents are FANTASTIC and always figure out the problem I am having quickly. The fix may be a simple click but it isn't easy for me as someone with limited computer skills to navigate and find.

投稿者: Lance アメリカのReservations Manager 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Checkfront - Not Enough"
良い点: Checkfront is a decent PMS and booking engine. It has a nice user interface for both front and back end users, good payment processing, decent reporting, and automated emails. They also have a nice little website builder if you are needing that.
改善点: Checkfront lacks an availability calendar for front end users, which is a feature that should be standard in today's industry. It is lacking in support features, and it could up its game in terms of the type of reporting it can offer.

投稿者: John オーストラリアのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great, simpler software for bookings"
良い点: Not as advanced as other booking softwares, Checkfront gets the job done if all you need to do is take customer details and control allocations. Customer service is top notch too.
改善点: Anything you need to do further, like API links to OTAs, are off-limits. The price is low, which is great, but there's a bit of "get what you pay for" going on here with the features list.

タイトル: Love this booking tool! Even for our odd use of it.

良い点: We don't use the booking software for its original purpose, but it still works great for us and the customer support works with us as though we are just as important as every other "typical" user. The system is easy to change to fit your needs and even though it is constantly evolving to get better, you don't sign in one day and feel completely lost.
改善点: I wish that it was purposefully made for our type of business, but that is by no fault of theirs. However, it is easily working its way to being exactly what we need it to be.
